tagline: A show about people who can't stop making things.
about: Room Tone is an independent interview show recorded in kitchens, barns, foundries, and one lamp room. Every other week, Mara Voss sits down with someone who has given a suspicious portion of their life to a craft — and stays until the room goes quiet enough to hear why.
No panel, no news hook, no fifteen-second version. One guest, one obsession, and the sound of the place where it happens.

host.name: Mara Voss
host.bio: Mara spent a decade as a location sound recordist before she started asking the questions herself. She still mixes every episode, and she still records the minute of silence — the room tone — before each interview. That minute is where the show got its name.

faqs.question: How often do new episodes come out?
faqs.answer: Every other Tuesday. Between seasons we post short field recordings from places we visited but couldn't fit into a full episode.

faqs.question: Can I suggest a guest?
faqs.answer: Please do — the seed vault episode started as a listener tip. Write to the studio with who they are and what they can't stop making. We read everything, even when we're slow to reply.

faqs.question: Where can I listen besides this site?
faqs.answer: Anywhere you already get podcasts — search for Room Tone. This page is the show's home: every episode here has chapter markers and a searchable transcript, which the apps still can't do.

faqs.question: Are the transcripts complete?
faqs.answer: Each episode page carries a transcript excerpt at launch, and full transcripts replace them as they're proofread. If you need one sooner for accessibility, email the studio and we'll move it up the queue.

faqs.question: Can I use clips from the show?
faqs.answer: For classrooms, community radio, or anything non-commercial: yes, with credit to Room Tone and a link to the episode page. For commercial use, write to the studio first — we usually say yes.
